cli_chrome_arguments: Section heading for positional arguments in `--help`. No colon: clap adds it.
cli_chrome_caused_by: Prefix of each underlying cause listed under a failure line (`  caused by: ...`). Keep the colon.
cli_chrome_commands: Section heading for the subcommands in `--help`. No colon: clap adds it.
cli_chrome_error: Prefix of a failure line printed by `atlas` for a person, in red. Keep the colon; the message follows after a space.
cli_chrome_help_subcommand: Description of the `help` subcommand row in the Commands section.
cli_chrome_help_subcommand_arg: Help text of the argument of the `help` subcommand (the name of the command to explain).
cli_chrome_options: Section heading for flags and options in `--help`. No colon: clap adds it.
cli_chrome_tip: Prefix of the suggestion clap prints under a usage error (for example a similar subcommand). Keep the colon.
cli_chrome_usage: Heading before the usage line of `--help`, e.g. "Usage: atlas config lang [TAG]". Keep the colon: it is part of this message, unlike the section headings below.
cli_chrome_warning: Prefix of a warning line printed by `atlas` for a person. Keep the colon.
